subject: The secret 87% of users discovered this week
preview_text: Your audio is still at factory settings while thousands just unlocked concert-level sound. Don't get left behind.
body_paragraphs: Okay, I need to confess something. We just watched 4,312 users do one specific thing in the app today. And the results were insane. Their average volume jumped from 'meh' to 'holy cow' in under 60 seconds. Meanwhile, your app icon is probably just sitting there, looking lonely.

Here's what happened: They didn't just tap the boost slider. They went straight for the genre presets in the EQ. The 'Electronic' and 'Rock' presets were the most popular. One user texted us saying their morning podcast in the car finally sounded clear over road noise. Another said their old playlists felt like new albums because the bass actually had punch. The common thread? They stopped treating their phone like a tin can and started treating it like a sound system.

This isn't about maxing out the volume bar. It's about using the right tool for your audio. The built-in equalizer has presets engineered for different content. Podcasts need clarity in the vocal range. Music needs that low-end warmth. The app does the technical work; you just pick your vibe. It's the difference between hearing sound and feeling it.

Open the app right now. Don't just boost. Tap the EQ icon, scroll through the presets (Pop, Rock, Jazz, etc.), and pick one for whatever you're listening to next. The change is instant. You'll know in the first 10 seconds if you've been missing out. P.S. The users who did this today are 3x more likely to keep the app long-term. This is the hack that turns downloaders into daily users.
